records.canonicalEnglish: Narrator: Sion and his companions arrived at the meteor crash site.

context.speaker: Sion / Shoko / Jido / narration
context.intent: Preserve the connected meteor event and the next destination.
context.tone: Grief, urgency and reassurance; retain uncertain claims as uncertain.

findings: Retains arrival, party and meteor site; all cinematic/event payloads and delay are preserved.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Sion: Dad! Hang on, Dad!
Jido: S... Sion... Shoko... Why... are you here...?
Sion: Never mind that. We need to treat your wounds, quickly...
Jido: I... won't... make it.
Shoko: Please! Don't die! Oh, Father... why did this happen...?
Jido: Listen... both of you... listen carefully... Joe... Scrap Joe... Go to him. He should... be able... to help you. What... happened... to Mamon...? They... were pursuing... someone who came in this meteor... It was... Al... sha... rk...!!
Sion: Dad! DAAAD! Damn it! Those Zolias soldiers... I'll never forgive them!

context.speaker: Sion / Shoko / Jido / narration
context.intent: Preserve the connected meteor event and the next destination.
context.tone: Grief, urgency and reassurance; retain uncertain claims as uncertain.

findings: Keeps the Scrap Joe destination, qualified help, Mamon question, pursuit and broken Alshark name. Please replaces Shoko's familiar address to Jido without inventing kinship. Her Father remains separate. Reduces pauses and treats who came in the meteor as unknown. Sion's refusal to forgive becomes Unforgivable; urgency remains in commands and exclamations. No new wait/clear controls.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Shoko: S... Sion... I don't know what to say. But please don't hate my father. There must be some explanation...
Sion: I know, Shoko. It's those Zolias soldiers who are to blame. They must have done something to Dr. Penrose. I'll... I'll uncover their secret and rescue him! So don't worry.
Shoko: Thank you, Sion.
Sion: ...Come on. Let's leave this place for now. They might come back.
Shoko: Yes. Let's go back to Cosma.

context.speaker: Sion / Shoko / Jido / narration
context.intent: Preserve the connected meteor event and the next destination.
context.tone: Grief, urgency and reassurance; retain uncertain claims as uncertain.

findings: Shoko's speechlessness is conveyed through her stammer; the explicit I do not know what to say is omitted. Sion addresses her by name and retains the suspicion that Zolias did something to Dr. Penrose, without specifying what. Omits separate reassurance I know and reduces thanks and agreement. Cosma destination remains explicit.
